write_vasp_input_files: write VASP input files for an ASE Atoms structure to a specified output directory
calculate_surface_k_points: calculate the k-point mesh for a surface calculation based on the unit cell size
clean_up_inputs: clean up ASE Atoms inputs by enforcing the right-hand rule and setting k-points
run_vasp_calculation: run a VASP calculation using an ASE Atoms object with custom flags and pseudopotentials
refactor_vasp_flags: refactor the VASP_FLAGS dictionary to customize default settings for VASP calculator input
